answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37751 Country: India Title: Chewing tobacco in any form (Example: Cigarette smoking, chaini khaini etc), is it Haram or gunah or halal Question: Chewing tobacco in any form (Example: Cigarette smoking, chaini khaini etc), is it Haram or gunah or halal? Please give answer with reference to the holy Quran and hadith? Answer ID: 37751 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 619/619/M=1433) If tobacco is injurious to body then its consumption is unlawful; otherwise it is allowable. And if the tobacco has bad smell or used as a fashion then it is makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
